name: The Divine Speaker: A Bounty Hunter's First Christmas
source:
The Divine Speaker: A Bounty Hunter's First Christmas is an 18+ Leos-centric afterstory to The Divine Speaker set during the Winter Solstice.

When Zarryn and Titus send the pair on a mission to hunt down the elusive Mister Bells, how will Raen and Leos manage to balance their first Winter Solstice and their (very well paying) job?

A hilarious story with hints about the future of The Divine Speaker awaits you!

[From [url=https://twoandahalfstudios.itch.io/the-divine-speaker-a-bounty-hunters-first-christmas]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《神语者：赏金猎人的第一个圣诞节》是一部以18岁以上青少狮为中心的《神语者》的后续故事，背景设定在冬至期间。

当扎林和泰特斯派两人执行追捕难以捉摸的贝尔先生的任务时，雷恩和利奥斯将如何平衡他们的第一个冬至和他们（报酬很高）的工作？

一个预示着神言者未来的搞笑故事正在等待着你！

[来自[url=https://twoandahalfstudios.itch.io/the-divine-speaker-a-bounty-hunters-first-christmas]itch.io[/url]]
